messages:
Lucas N: Morning — quick onboarding check-in. What I did: finished Mac setup, installed Docker, got the dev server running locally (had some permission warnings but app boots). I also pulled the redwood/examples repo and ran the test suite.

Blockers: still can't access private repo `redwood/core-models` — Okta SSO gives 403. I opened a ticket but not sure which group I need to be in. Also VPN drops after ~20m, which kills my dev session (openvpn client shows disconnect). I filed INC-2345.

Today: pair with @Sam at 11:30 on PR 238 (telemetry shim), try to add the metrics tag fix, and get a first PR up for review. Also wondering where the SDK docs style guide lives. Ping me if I should join the runtime guild sync at 14:00. @Sam @Alex (infra)

Sam R: Hey Lucas — good progress. For the repo access, Alex should be able to add you to the eng-models Okta group; I just pinged him. For the SDK style guide, we keep it in the docs repo: https://git.redwood.internal/docs/style-guides.md (private link). I can pair at 11:30 — send a calendar invite. :thumbsup:

Alex (infra): Added Lucas to eng-models group and re-synced permissions. Try again and paste the exact error if you still see 403. For the VPN drops — what client/version are you using? If it's OpenVPN, paste `openvpn --version` output.

Lucas N: Thanks Alex — repo access works now, I can clone and push. VPN still flaky though, here's the client log snippet when it disconnects:
```
May 01 10:21:14 TCP connection established
May 01 10:41:18 [ERROR] TLS handshake failed: EOF
May 01 10:41:18 SIGUSR1[soft,tls-error] received, process restarting
```
If someone from infra can check gateway logs around 10:41 that would be awesome.

Maria G: Nice traction — solid. For SDK docs, follow `docs/templates/sdk.md` in the docs repo. For PR 238 please add a unit test for metrics parsing (one small JSON case is enough). Happy to review after you push.

onboarding-bot: Welcome Lucas! Reminder: complete Security & Data Handling training by EOD Friday. Link: https://learning.redwood.internal/onboarding/courses/security

Sam R: Quick tip — Mac VPN flakiness sometimes due to PF rules. For testing you can try `sudo pfctl -d` to disable packet filter temporarily. If that helps we can follow up with infra to add a persistent fix.

Lucas N: Update — I can push now and requested review from Maria. Repo access ✅. Will try the pfctl suggestion and report back. Thanks all!
